# Gekko Lizzaro’s Accelerator Adventure: RampMeDaddy Joins Draper University’s Program
## It’s Official!
It’s official—Gekko Lizzaro has scaled yet another peak in his mission to make memecoins accessible to everyone! 🚀 Our beloved gecko-turned-memecoin maestro has been welcomed into the **Stellar Embark Accelerator** at Draper University, and to say he’s excited would be an understatement.
![Gekko Image](https://rampmedaddy.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/GEKKO-250109_027-1024x1024.png)
Gekko has always been inspired by **Tim Draper’s** bold vision for innovation and entrepreneurship, so joining the Draper Family feels like a major milestone. “Tim’s approach to empowering founders is legendary,” Gekko said with his trademark tail-wiggle. “Being part of a Draper-backed program is an incredible opportunity to push RampMeDaddy even further.”
But let’s not forget that an accelerator of this caliber doesn’t just run on excitement—it’s powered by some incredible people. Huge shoutout to **Aaliyah** and **Arisa**, the dynamic duo running the day-to-day operations at Stellar Embark. They keep the energy high, the schedules tight, and the milestones within reach. Gekko swears he’s grown more efficient (and maybe even a tad more professional?) thanks to their hard work.
![Gekko Image 2](https://rampmedaddy.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/GEKKO-250111_035-1024x1024.png)
And then there’s **Suffiyan**, the mastermind behind all those epic events that make the program unforgettable. From networking nights to startup showcases, Suffiyan knows how to mix business with pleasure. Gekko’s been to some top-notch conferences in his time, but these events? They’re next-level—almost as smooth as buying memecoins with RampMeDaddy inside Telegram.
A special shoutout also goes to **Asra**, the powerhouse CEO of Draper University, whose leadership has created an environment where founders like Gekko can thrive. “Asra has built something extraordinary here,” Gekko said, pausing between sips of his morning (crypto-themed) latte. “She’s unlocked a space where dreams become ventures—and I’m thrilled to be part of it.”
As Gekko dives into the program, he’s laser-focused on taking RampMeDaddy to the next level. With the Stellar Embark Accelerator behind him and the Draper Family cheering him on, the skies are looking brighter than ever.
Stay tuned for more adventures as Gekko gears up for his next big leap. If there’s one thing we’ve learned, it’s that when Gekko’s around, innovation—and a little chaos—is always just around the corner. 🌟
